weapons.name: Model 52
weapons.source_note: Winchester-Western Firearms Catalog 1965, "MODEL 52D TARGET RIFLE SPECIFICATIONS" table: "Rate of Twist* 16" 16" / One turn in". The maker's own catalog lists the Model 52D (the Model 52 target rifle then in production) at one turn in 16 inches. A 1 turn in 16 inch twist = 16 x 25.4 = 406.4 mm per turn. Groove count is not stated in this table.

weapons.name: Model 69
weapons.source_note: Collector forum post quoting a Winchester factory specification sheet: "I have a Winchester document dated 8/2/1957 which lists the 69A chambered for the 22 short, long and long rifle at 1-16, bore dia of .217\" and 4 groove." The quoted maker's figure states one turn in 16 inches and 4 grooves for the Model 69/69A. A 1 turn in 16 inch twist = 16 x 25.4 = 406.4 mm per turn. Source is a forum transcription of the Winchester document, not the document itself.

weapons.name: RPK-74M Light Machine Gun
weapons.source_note: Specification table for the RPK-74M: "Нарезы 4 прав." and "Длина хода нарезов, мм 200". The source states 4 right-hand grooves and a rifling pitch (one turn) of 200 mm, so twist = 200.0 mm per turn.
